description: A rare open space in the forest. A circle of mushrooms grows in the center. The air is slightly fresher here.

wall.description: The surrounding trees are slightly thinner here, but still impassable.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A hollow tree stump filled with rotting leaves.
item.onCollect: You search inside the decaying mossy stump and retrieve a plump, dirty Wild Potato!

hollow_stump.description: An ancient, hollow tree stump covered in soft green moss.

butterfly_shrub.onInteract: You watch a flutter of glowing butterflies with delicate, shoelace-like wings resting on the leaves. They sparkle gently when you approach.
butterfly_shrub.description: A flowering bush humming with glowing shoelace-wing butterflies.

exit_west.description: The path leads back into the deep forest.

exit_south.description: The path leads south toward a damp marsh.

item_mushrooms.description: A circle of glowing mushrooms. They look slightly magical.
item_mushrooms.onInteract: You step into the fairy ring. The mushrooms pulse with a faint, warm starchy light and a quiet hum fills your sole.
